en.En 2e : 7e partiel, 2e rentrée. La 4e (8: In 2nd: 7th partial, 2nd brought in. The 4th (8th partial) is in tune.

en.En 4e (10e partiel) un peu basse : rentr: In 4th (10th partial) a bit flat: bring in slightly.
en.En 5e : 5e partiel, un peu bas, rentrer: In 5th: 5th partial, a bit flat, bring in slightly.

en.Si♭ grave. La clé de do grave (main droi: Low B♭. Charts show the low C key (right hand); on most modern saxophones it closes by itself.
